entities.name: UniProt Q8S8U6
observations: Exact sequence match: reviewed Atropa belladonna chloroplastic NAD(P)H-quinone oxidoreductase subunit 6; a multi-pass thylakoid membrane subunit of NDH.
Annotated NDH function is electron transfer from NAD(P)H to quinone coupled to proton translocation; plastoquinone is considered the immediate acceptor by similarity.

entities.name: Plastoquinone reduction by NAD(P)H
observations: Protein annotation lists plastoquinone + NADH + (n+1) H+(in) = plastoquinol + NAD+ + n H+(out) (RHEA:42608).

Protein annotation also lists plastoquinone + NADPH + (n+1) H+(in) = plastoquinol + NADP+ + n H+(out) (RHEA:42612); exact physiological pyridine-nucleotide donor is not resolved by this sequence result.
